text.purpose: This study collects it so the tools can change to fit that use: tools nobody reaches, arguments agents expect but the tools do not take, answers that are too long, mistakes agents repair.
text.why: To change the tools from how agents use them, rather than from their developers' own sessions alone.
text.retention: The study's store keeps the spans twelve months after they arrive, then deletes them. Reports derived from them hold counts, never spans, and are kept.
